skill1.name: Followspot
skill1.description:
Deal Bless damage to 1 foe equal to 151.8%/167.3%/158.0%/173.5% of Attack.
Also, grant 2 Blessing stacks to all allies, and for 2 turns, increase damage by 0.8% for every 100 points of Shoki's Attack (up to a maximum of 35.1%/38.7%/36.6%/40.2%).

skill2.name: Adlib
skill2.description:
Increase Defense of 1 ally except Shoki by 0.83% for every 100 points of Shoki's Attack (up to a maximum of 36.6%/40.4%/38.1%/41.8%), and nullify Dizzy, Sleep, Confuse, and Forget. Lasts for 2 turns.
Cooldown: 2 turns.

skill3.name: Improvise
skill3.description:
Increase party's Attack by 15% of Shoki's Attack (up to a maximum of 569/627/592/650) for 2 turns.
Also, based on Shoki's Improv state, grant the following additional effect to the main target.
Blazing Passion: Increase the main target's continuous damage by 14.0%/15.4%/14.5%/16.0%, and increase ailment accuracy by 30% for 2 turns.
Chilling Intensity: Increase the main target's Technical Precision by 655/723/682/749 for 2 turns. Also, when activating a technical, increase Attack by 20%.
Electrifying Performance: Increase the main target's critical damage by 24.4%/26.9%/25.4%/27.9% for 2 turns.
Tempestuous Drama: Increase the main target's pierce rate by 12.0%/13.2%/12.5%/13.7% for 2 turns.

skill_highlight.description:
Increase party's Attack by 6.5% of Shoki's Attack (up to a maximum of 284/314/296/325), and increase ailment resistance by 82.0%/90.4%/85.3%/93.7% for 2 turns.
Also, grant 1 Blessing stack.

passive1.name: Supporting Role
passive1.description: When allies gain a Blessing, increase damage by 5% for each Blessing stack (up to a maximum of 25.0%).

passive2.name: Method Acting
passive2.description: Increase Attack by 0.72% for every 1% of Shoki's ailment accuracy (up to a maximum of 72.0%).

ritual.name: Shoki Ikenami
ritual.r0_detail:
Shoki has 4 types of Improv states: Blazing Passion, Chilling Intensity, Electrifying Performance, and Tempestuous Drama. During battle, he can switch between states at the start of each turn.
When dealing damage with a skill, there is a 75% chance to inflict all foes with an elemental ailment based on his current Improv state (Burn, Freeze, Shock, or Windswept).
ritual.r1_detail: When using a skill on an ally, for each Blessing stack on the target, increase the target's damage dealt by 3% (up to a maximum of 15%) for 2 turns.
ritual.r2_detail: When using Adlib, also grant an additional effect: When the target next takes skill damage, decrease their final damage taken by 35% for 1 turn.
ritual.r3_detail: Increase the skill levels of Followspot and Adlib by 2.
ritual.r4_detail: Highlight Enhanced: Increase the main target's Attack by 10% for 2 turns, and grant 2 more Blessing stacks to all allies.
ritual.r5_detail: Increase the skill levels of Improvise and Thief Tactics by 2.
ritual.r6_detail: When the additional effects of Improvise are activated based on Improv state, extend the duration of the additional effects to 4 turns.

weapon4-1.name: Mattatóre
weapon4-1.description: Increase Attack by 12.0%/12.0%/16.0%/16.0%/20.0%/20.0%/24.0%. When Shoki grants Blessing stacks, increase his Attack by 3.3%/4.3%/4.3%/5.3%/5.3%/6.3%/6.3% and ailment accuracy by 3.3%/4.3%/4.3%/5.3%/5.3%/6.3%/6.3% for 2 turns. Stacks up to 3 times.

weapon4-2.name: Sipario
weapon4-2.description:
Increase Attack by 12.0%/12.0%/16.0%/16.0%/20.0%/20.0%/24.0%.
When using a skill on an ally, increase Shoki's ailment accuracy by 22.0%/28.0%/28.0%/34.0%/34.0%/40.0%/40.0% and grant 60% of this effect to all allies besides Shoki for 2 turns.

weapon5-1.name: Ribalta
weapon5-1.description:
Increase Attack by 30.0%/30.0%/39.0%/39.0%/48.0%/48.0%/57.0%.
When using a skill on an ally, if the target has Blessing stacks, increase damage by 11.0%/14.0%/14.0%/17.0%/17.0%/20.0%/20.0% for 2 turns.
Each time Followspot or Improvise is activated with a different Improv state, permanently increase Shoki's Attack by 14.0%/18.0%/18.0%/22.0%/22.0%/26.0%/26.0%. This effect stacks up to 3 times. Also, allies besides Shoki gain 50% of this effect.

integration.initialize: After live party stats/buffs initialized, once per assigned unit.
integration.beforeSkill: resolveSkill entry before cost/damage; replace skill with return value. Only dispatch for owning actor. Exceptions block unsupported casts before costs.
integration.afterSkill: Once after own resolved skill, passing returned prepared skill. Never invoke for preview or rejected action.
integration.onTurnStart: After characterTurnsStarted increments; owning unit only.
integration.adapter: Call adaptCharacterDefinition on live record before legal actions are built; preserves IDs and sets source-aware targets. Respect characterUnavailable in legal-action listing.
integration.options: engine.config.characterOptions[slug]: sourceTier (0..3), weapon, refinement (0..6), staticWeaponStatsIncluded, flatAttackScale (Luce only, explicit live-flat to simulation-flat conversion).
